name: Harmony 650, the whole Plasma on seven pages
description: todo-compile-650 2.4, one write of lab/work/bench-2-4/h650-full-plasma.bin: the Panasonic TX-P42GT30E as 'Plasma' with every command its catalogue entry holds, 63 of 63, laid out the way Logitech's compiler lays out a device (section 325), composed onto the 650's own configuration (h650_panasonic_config). Keep the remote pointed at the Flirc. The three buttons below the screen are the left arrow, the centre button and the right arrow; the four buttons beside the screen each choose the label in the corner next to them.

steps.instruction: Start on the remote's ordinary screen. Press the centre button below the screen ('Devices'). Expect 'Devices 1/2' with PS3 top left, KPN top right, Kodi bottom left and TV bottom right. Press the right arrow. Expect 'Devices 2/2' with Denon top left, Panasonic TV top right and Plasma bottom left. The Flirc hears nothing

Press the button beside Plasma (bottom left). Expect 'Plasma 1/7' with 'Power Toggle' top left, 'Power On' top right, 'Power Off' bottom left, 'Teletext' bottom right, and 'Back' at the bottom. Press Power On once, briefly: expect the Plasma's PowerOn seven times in one burst. Then press Power Off once: expect its PowerOff seven times in one burst

Press the right arrow once per page and check each page's four corners (top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right). 2/7: Aspect, Return, 3D, AV. 3/7: Direct TVRecord, Input Component, Input Hdmi1, Input Hdmi2. 4/7: Input HDMI3, Input Hdmi4, InputPc, Input Video1. 5/7: Input Video2, Internet, Option, Surround. 6/7: Teletext Hold, Teletext Index, Teletext Subtitle, TV. 7/7: Viera Link, Viera Tools, and nothing below them. The Flirc hears nothing. Mark the step if a label is missing, misplaced or drawn oddly; page 3's top left label is the one most likely to look wrong
Press the left arrow until the screen shows 3/7, then press the button beside Input Hdmi1 (bottom left) once. Expect the Plasma's InputHdmi1 three times

Still on the Plasma's pages, press each of these hard keys once, briefly, with a second between them: Volume up, Channel up, the digit 1, OK, Menu. Expect the Plasma's own command for each: VolumeUp, ChannelUp, the digit 1, the OK or Select command, and Menu. Mark the step with what the Flirc showed if any key sends something else or nothing
Press All Off. Expect the Flirc to hear nothing: no activity switched the Plasma on, so the remote counts it as off. If the Flirc hears anything, say what with the mark button
